referee_caveats_inferred: The excess estimate depends on an ad hoc choice of control fraction (32-36%) and the binomial error ignores positional uncertainty and control-sample variance
Small samples (32 SNe, 4 SESNe, 6 SNe Ia) give large uncertainties; the SN Ia value is quoted as 17% in the table and 20% in the text
MUSE resolution of 33-104 pc exceeds typical H II region sizes so coincidence is line-of-sight overlap, not physical association
ALMA data are only used as a detection flag, so ALMA-specific processing is entirely delegated to Leroy et al. 2021 and Mayker Chen et al. 2023
